title: Modified paired end rapid library preparation protocol for 454 GS Junior 8 kb library preparation using Covaris g-tubes and BluePippin electrophoresis
protocol: Start with 15 µg of sample genomic DNA in 150 µL Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Save a few μl of original genomic DNA to visualize on an agarose gel later.
Add the 150 µL genomic DNA prep to a g-tube.
Spin the g-tube in an Eppendorf MiniSpin plus microcentrifuge at 8,600 rpm for 1 min.
Flip tube over and repeat spin.
Remove sample from tube.
Keep 2 μl of sheared sample to run on an agarose gel later.
Set waterbath to maintain a temperature of 25°C throughout the protocol.
Change the 2x rapid ligase buffer for 10x rapid ligase buffer from New England Biolabs product.
Reduce mixture volume to 100 µL by adding only 10 µL of buffer instead of the original amount.
Stop at the end of Step 4 and disregard Steps 5-11.
Save a few µL of the sample pre-loading to run on an agarose gel later.
Bring the sample volume to 120 µL with Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Add 40 µL BluePippin loading dye to the sample.
Prepare Blue Pippin cassette according to instructions.
Load 4 lanes of a cassette by adding 40 µL of sample into each lane.
Load the 5th lane with BluePippin marker.
Run the BluePipin with the range selection from 5,000-11,000 bp.
Remove the size-selected DNA from the elution well and transfer to a microfuge tube.
Rise the elution chamber with 40 µL 0.1% Tween 20 solution and add it to the tube containing the sample.
Concentrate and wash the size-selected sample by loading all the BluePipin eluted DNA into an Amicon filter column (0.5 mL, 10 K).
Spin for 10 min at 14,000 x g.
Discard flow-thru and add 250 µL Tris-HCl to the column.
Spin for 15 min at 14,000 x g.
Invert the column in a clean collection tube and spin for 2 min at 1,000 x g.
Save a few µL of concentrated sample to run on an agarose gel later.
Run an agarose gel of the original genomic DNA (unsheared).
Run an agarose gel of the g-tube sheared DNA.
Run an agarose gel of the sample before BluePipping.
Run an agarose gel of the sample after BluePippin.
Prepare 2x Library Binding Buffer by mixing 5 mL Molecular Biology Grade Water, 4 mL of 5 M NaCl and 1 mL of 10x TE.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 25°C for 1 hour in a thermocycler.
Prepare the PCR mixture as indicated for the sample and a second mixture to run without sample as a negative control.
Save a few μL of the sample PCR after amplification and the negative PCR sample to run on the BioAnalyzer chip at the end.
Use BioAnalyzer chip and run the PCR sample and negative control from Section 3.12, as well as the final sample.
Quantify final sample using Life Technologies’s Qubit ssDNA quantification kit.
